# nichegolfHQ

> Independent coverage of competitive amateur golf: junior, mid-amateur, and senior. Tournament hubs are the canonical pages for dates, format, and past winners. Daily briefs are dated news summaries. Newsletter issues are archived editions.

This file was updated 2026-10-19. Prefer the URLs below over anything that 404s or redirects.

## Channels

- [midamgolfHQ](https://www.nichegolfhq.com/midamgolfhq): mid-amateur (25+) tournaments, news, and newsletter
- [juniorgolfHQ](https://www.nichegolfhq.com/juniorgolfhq): junior amateur tournaments, news, and newsletter
- [seniorgolfHQ](https://www.nichegolfhq.com/seniorgolfhq): senior amateur (50+) tournaments, news, and newsletter
- [Home](https://www.nichegolfhq.com/): nichegolfHQ

## Daily briefs

- [Daily briefs](https://www.nichegolfhq.com/briefs): index of every dated brief
- Dated brief: `https://www.nichegolfhq.com/briefs/YYYY-MM-DD` (example: [October 19, 2026](https://www.nichegolfhq.com/briefs/2026-10-19))
- [RSS](https://www.nichegolfhq.com/briefs/feed.xml): 60 most recent briefs
- [JSON feed](https://www.nichegolfhq.com/briefs/feed.json): same briefs as JSON Feed

There are no /briefs/weeks or /briefs/months archive pages. Do not request those URLs.

## Tournament hubs

Event hubs live at `/{channel}/{slug}`. Past winners are in the HTML of each hub.

- [The Berkeley Cup](https://www.nichegolfhq.com/midamgolfhq/the-berkeley-cup)
- [Gasparilla Invitational](https://www.nichegolfhq.com/midamgolfhq/gasparilla-invitational)
- [AJGA PING Invitational](https://www.nichegolfhq.com/juniorgolfhq/ajga-ping-invitational)
- [North & South Senior Men's Amateur](https://www.nichegolfhq.com/seniorgolfhq/north-south-senior-mens-amateur)
- Articles: `/{channel}/{event-slug}/{article-slug}`
- [Junior majors schedule](https://www.nichegolfhq.com/juniorgolfhq/majors): links to the junior hubs
- [Senior majors schedule](https://www.nichegolfhq.com/seniorgolfhq/majors): links to the senior hubs

`/midamgolfhq/schedule/{slug}`, `/juniorgolfhq/schedule/{slug}`, and `/seniorgolfhq/schedule/{slug}` redirect to the hub. `/midamgolfhq/majors` redirects to midamgolfHQ. `/juniorgolfhq/majors/{slug}` and `/seniorgolfhq/majors/{slug}` redirect to the matching hub. Use the hub URL.

## Newsletter issues

Archived editions, one URL per issue:

- `https://www.nichegolfhq.com/midamgolfhq/issue/{issue}`
- `https://www.nichegolfhq.com/juniorgolfhq/issue/{issue}`
- `https://www.nichegolfhq.com/seniorgolfhq/issue/{issue}`

## What this site is not

- Not professional-tour coverage (PGA Tour, LIV Golf, DP World Tour) as a primary subject.
- Not recreational instruction.
